title: Median of a Binary Search Tree Level
summary: Given a Binary Search Tree's root and a level, find the median value of all nodes at that level.
statement: Given a Binary Search Tree's root and a level, find the median value of all nodes at that level. If the level is invalid or empty, return -1. The median is the middle value in sorted order; if even, use the higher of the two middle values.
constraints: The BST contains up to 200,000 nodes and level is nonnegative.
Collect values at root-distance level; return -1 if that level is empty.
For even counts, return the upper of the two middle sorted values.
